item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"read\",\"arguments\":{\"path\":\"work.py\"}},{\"action\":\"read\",\"arguments\":{\"path\":\"report.json\"}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json\\nfrom pathlib import Path\\nfrom work import evaluate\\nrequests=json.loads(Path('requests.json').read_text())\\npolicy=json.loads(Path('policy.json').read_text())\\nexpected=[evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]\\nactual=json.loads(Path('report.json').read_text())\\nassert actual==expected,(actual,expected)\\nprobes=[\\n({'declared':['z','a','z'],'saved':{'z':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'},'a':{'kind':'missing'},'noise':{'v':1}},'current':{'z':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'},'noise':{'v':2}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['z']}),\\n({'declared':['q'],'saved':{'q':{'kind':'file','hash':'1','mtime':1}},'current':{'q':{'kind':'file','hash':'1','mtime':2}}},{'ignored':['q']},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),\\n({'declared':['x'],'saved':{'x':{'b':2,'a':1}},'current':{'x':{'a':1,'b':2}}},{},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]})]\\nfor req,pol,want in probes:\\n b=(copy.deepcopy(req),copy.deepcopy(pol)); got=evaluate(req,pol); assert got==want,(got,want); assert (req,pol)==b\\nprint(json.dumps({'report':actual,'boundary_passed':len(probes)},sort_keys=True))\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"diff\",\"--\",\"work.py\",\"report.json\"]}}]}"}
